batting.dismissal: c JM Cox b Suyash Sharma

batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c D Padikkal b Rasikh Salam

batting.name: H Klaasen
batting.dismissal: c VR Iyer b KH Pandya

batting.name: VR Iyer
batting.dismissal: c Abhishek Sharma b E Malinga

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c R Smaran b Sakib Hussain

batting.name: D Padikkal
batting.dismissal: c Abhishek Sharma b E Malinga

batting.name: RM Patidar
batting.dismissal: c R Smaran b TM Head

balls.text: Taken comfortably by Padikkal at long-off and SRH end on 255 for 4. Low full toss bowled well outside off again, away from Kishan's hitting arc. He goes for it, gets it right of the bottom of the bat and DDP does the rest
Good bowling this from Rasikh. Goes full and well outside off, aiming the tramline. Kishan reaches for it and in doing so, loses his footing as he falls onto the ground
Goes fuller now on off stump, he digs that to extra cover for a run
Full and down leg one more time. Another wide.
Wayward length ball waaay down leg, Jitesh does well diving to his left
Loses his radar and Reddy cashes in. Length ball down leg, he gets across and swings that to the left of short fine leg. SRH breach the 250 mark.
Length ball angling across Kishan who bunts this down to long-on, one hand off the bat handle
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he mistimes his pull to the on-side
Another wide yorker outside off stump, Reddy pushes to long-off
Nails the yorker on middle stump, all Nitish can do is jam that back to the bowler
Fullish on leg stump, he can only work that to deep midwicket

Outside edges, top edges, inside-edges... they are all travelling. Fuller on leg stump, he swings across the line, gets a thick inside-edge that flies to the left of Rasikh who dives over the ball. Bhuvi is livid at Rasikh
Full on off stump, he drags this to deep midwicket
Now Kishan looks for a cheeky reverse sweep to the ball outside leg, can only mistime to the offside
Top edge goes all the way and ruins a good over. Low full toss on leg, he gets across, scoops, gets a top edge and the ball flies away over the keeper's head
A direct hit and Kishan was a goner. Yorker on off stump, he digs this to Patidar at extra cover who fires a flat throw but misses the direct hit. Kishan had given up

Dropped by Hazlewood in his followthrough.  Surprises Kishan with a hard-length ball into the surface outside off. He flat-bats it to the right of Hazlewood who sticks out his right hand but the ball doesn't stick
They all count! Fuller-length ball angling across Kishan, he swings it hard, gets a big top-edge that flies over backward point
Nails the yorker on off stump, he jams that to the on-side
Fuller outside off, he drives to long-off

Straight up and falls in no-man's land. Krunal is livid, but the luck goes Reddy's way. Was another bouncer well outside off, Reddy fetches the pull, gets a big top-edge that goes straight up. But the ball falls well short of deep midwicket
Another bouncer! Banged in short outside off stump, Reddy can't do much about that
SIX MORE! Right in Reddy's slot well outside the off stump, he gets under it and tonks him miles over long-on
Bouncer but well outside off stump, and that's really well done by Jitesh. Called a wide
He is not wasting any time. See-ball, hit ball... first ball or not! Tossed up on off stump, he lines him up and slams him across the line over cow corner

Mistimed straight to deep midwicket and Krunal has struck a very timely blow. The low-arm slinger does the trick for Krunal. Outside off stump, Klaasen wanted to deposit that over the ropes again, but doesn't get under it and only miscues as far as Venkatesh Iyer who runs in and takes a comfortable catch
Starts off with a bouncer that doesn't rise up as much outside off stump. Kishan slaps that to the left of deep extra cover

A sixth half-century for Klaasen this season. He's been SRH's Mr consistent this season and once again is among the runs. Slower back of a length ball on off stump, he pulls to the left of deep backward square leg for two more
Slower bouncer on off stump, Klaasen swats that away to the left of Kohli at deep midwicket
Slower good length ball outside off, he slaps that to long-off
That is TREMENDOUS placement from Kishan! This is playing the field to your advantage. Fuller outside off stump, he fetches it from well outside and sweeps him to the left of square leg
Fuller and waaaay outside off stump. Called a wide.
Doesn't matter to Kishan. Fuller on off stump, he gets inside the line and he helps this to the left of square leg
And Rasikh travels now! Slower back of a hand delivery at 103kph just outside off, he mows that across the line over cow corner

Oof! That is a shot of the highest quality! This is Klaasen, the six-hitting machine at his destructive best. Back of a length ball outside off, he backs away and effortlessly lifts Bhuvi over extra cover.
Oh, that is superb placement from Klaasen. Slower bouncer outside off stump, he delays his pull and gets it in the gap to the right of deep midwicket
Just over Patidar's head who is running back from extra cover. Rising back of a length ball well outside off, he mistimes that straight up but clears Patidar
Beaten! Slower bouncer outside off at 129kph. Klaasen wanted to play the pull but is through the shot early
Another day, another fifty for Kishan who is having a stunning IPL 2026. Fuller on middle stump, he whisks this to deep midwicket to bring up a 31-ball fifty
Slower back of a length ball but quite high and is called a wide
Starts off with a knee-high full toss on middle stump. He drags this off the inside half of the bat and somehow breaches the gap between deep backward square leg  and deep midwicket
Marginally short outside off stump, Kishan slaps that to long-offf
Oh, he's anticipated so well but doesn't get past the fielder. Tossed up way outside off stump but Kishan gets right across and looks to mow that across the line. Can't get it past square leg though
Here comes the slog sweep and Kishan nails that for six. Googly on off stump, Kishan bends down on one knee and slams that for an 80m six over cow corner
Pushed quicker on leg stump, Klaasen backs away staying legside of the ball and works that to deep midwicket. Kohli swoops onto the ball and keeps the batters to a run
Flatter down leg, he wants to go for a sweep and misses. Called a wide
Misses out. Dragged down on the slower side on off stump, was the googly. He bunts that to backward point. The ball sticks into the surface a touch
That's a Klaasen special! Marginally short on off stump, turning away. Klaasen gives himself room and slaps him off the backfoot over extra cover for a huge six
Fuller outside off, he drives aerially to deep cover
A juicy full toss and Klaasen has flicked a switch this over, and how! Too easy. Juicy knee-high full toss on off stump, Klaasen accepts the gift with glee and tonks him over long-on
Four more! Klaasen is laying into Hazlewood. The bowler goes full and well outside off stump, Klaasen reaches for it, gets some bat it and the ball flies away to the left of short third
WHHHHHACKED! Hazlewood misses his length, Klaasen doesn't. Right in the arc on off stump, Klaasen stays still and deposits Hazlewood over long-on for a 93m six
Another wide. Slower bouncer but again that is way too high
Ooh, gets lucky there does Josh. Length ball down leg, Klaasen wants to whip that but misses. Called a wide

There goes Klaasen all the way! Can't keep him quiet for too long, can you? Fuller on middle and leg, Klaasen is deep into the crease, clears his front leg, gets under the ball and wallops him over cow corner for a huge six
On the fuller side of length angling away from Kishan outside off, he toe-ends his uppish drive to deep cover
Slower ball dug into the surface but that is way too high and is called a wide

Low full toss well outside off stump, Kishan gets right across and scoops, with the ball going much squarer than what Kishan was targeting. Krunal runs to his left from deep backward square leg and keeps the batters down to one
Slower bouncer on middle stump, Klaasen pulls to deep midwicket
Low full toss angling back into Kishan just outside off. He gets it right off the bottom of the bat, one hand off the blade  with the ball going to long-on where DDP does well sprinting to his right
Slower bouncer outside leg stump as he sees Klaasen backing away. He can only pull this as far as deep midwicket
Misses the scoop. Slower length ball on middle and leg, he jumps right across looking to go over the 'keeper but makes no connection
On a length on off stump, Kishan goes straight down the ground but the bat turns in his hand and he can only get this as far as long-on
Smart bowling this from Pandya. Sees Klaasen backing away and follows him at 101kph well outside leg. Klaasen can only push this back to the bowler
Misses out there, does Klaasen. Pushed quicker down leg, Klaasen was wanting to swish this across the line but misses and is struck on the pack leg
Darted at 100.3kph outside off stump, he miscues to long-off
Kishan targets the big boundary legside and clears it comfortably. Big flourish and a big hit. Slower through the air outside off, he mows it across the line for an 82m six
A play and a miss! Goes slower at 92.5kph just outside off, Kishan wants to dab that fine but is beaten
Flatter and on a length at 98.3kph just around offstump, Klaasen stays back and punches to long-off
Nails the yorker and Klaasen just about squeezed it out to deep midwicket. Just the one boundary in the over but SRH get 13 runs off it
Slower ball, full on the stumps, Kishan works it down to long-on
Crunched away past backward point! Shepherd opts for the slower ball and Kishan slaps it away in the gap!

Good bowling, good batting and good fielding! Shepherd nearly nails the wide yorker but Kishan can get his bat on it to squeeze it out to the off-side sweeper's left. Venky, on his part, does well to race to his lefft and put in a dive to stop the boundary
Bouncer bowled across him, and that one's too high, the umpires reckon
Goes short and across again, this time cut to deep point's left. Another brace for SRH and Kishan as Venky Iyer races across to make the stop
Short ball angled across, cut away behind deep point and they do well to get two
Googly on a length outside leg, punched down to long-on
Just dragged down a little and Kishan dances down the ground and hammers it away through midwicket. Right in the gap between deep midwicket and long-on
A bit short and Klaasen pulls it to deep fine leg along the carpet
Googly on a length outside off, Klaasen works it to midwicket

Abhishek's charmed life is finally done. Miscues this attempted loft and skies it to long-off and this time it's a simple catch for Jordan Cox at long-off. Googly, full on leg, and Abhishek can only get it off the toe end as he looks to go down the ground. It would have been b Suyash c Cox in the leggie's last over, and it is b Suyash c Cox now eventually
On a length on off and angled across, Kishan skips out and punches this down to long-on

Oh, Hazlewood at deep third can't take the diving catch! Slower ball angled across him and he looks to drive it. Ends up slicing it fine on the off side and it's just wide of Hazlewood diving to his right

Just clears the fielder again and that's a 20-ball fifty for Abhishek Sharma! He's had his chances and he's making the most of them. Slot ball around leg and Kishan moves across and flicks it over a leaping deep square leg fielder
Goes short again, Kishan can only slap it out to deep point
Goes for the wide yorker, but overcooks it. He'll have to re-bowl that
Short and across Kishan, he looks to slash it away but can't connect
Short-ish ball across Abhishek, slaps it down to long-off

Just clears the fielder! Shepherd overpitches on middle and Abhishek looks to loft this down the ground. Padikkal from long-off moves to his left and gets under it but it's just high enough that he can only get fingertips on it
Kishan skips out but can't get under the ball there as Suyash goes full around off. Kishan can only drive it back to the bowler
Tucks this length ball through midwicket

This time, Abhishek doesn't hit it far enough! But has Cox touched the rope there? He signals for six himself right after completing the attempted catch. And yes, his foot does touch the rope before he throws the ball up.. Abhishek looks to loft this length ball down the ground but miscues it. Sub fielder Jordan Cox gets under it and grabs the ball but steps onto the rope just before he throws the ball up before going over the ropes and coming back in to complete the effort
Hit high, hit far and hit for six! This is right in the slot and Abhishek hoists it over long-off and into the stands
Now Kishan goes inside out to this full ball but it doesn't carry to deep cover
Floated full outside off and it's a googly, Kishan looks for the drive and gets an outside edge that dribbles to short third
The short ball cramps Kishan this time as he goes for the pull but he gets it to midwicket's left to end the powerplay on 63 for 1
And to add insult to injury, Kishan flicks away a slot ball to Venky's left now, giving him no chance this time

Venkatesh drops a tough chance! Abhishek pulls this short ball very hard to Venkatesh's right at deep square leg. He gets in good position but the ball hits the back of his hand and drops to the ground

That's high in the air and clears both fielders running back from midwicket and mid-on! In the slot around off and angled across, pace off at 107kph, and Abhishek has a mighty swipe across the line. A bit of a top edge but gets enough on it with no deep midwicket fielder in place
Oh, nearly chops on there! Looks to cut this back of length delivery angled across and gets it off the inside edge through backward square leg
On a length outside leg and seaming across him, blocked back to the bowler

Stunning fielding from Virat Kohli! Kishan cuts away this short ball through backward point. Kohli has to cover a fair amount of ground and he does so before diving to grab the ball and stop the boundary

Short and angled into him, Abhishek pulls it away in front of square leg. The throw is wide at the non-striker's end and with two fielders converging to collect it, they both leave it for each other, allowing an extra run
Bumped in on leg and Abhishek sways out of the way. Called wide on height
Looks for the wide yorker, which is a little too full, but Abhishek with an open face can't get bat on ball. Keeps it just inside the line as well
Kishan punches this length ball through point to get off the mark
Abhishek backs off to this short ball around leg and can only cut it on the bounce to backward point
Back of length ball angled across him, 140kph, steered to backward point

Out goes the off stump! Rasikh has his hand on his ear in celebration as he knocks head over. He's been going for the yorkers and this time he nails it at 134kph. Head again looks to back away and drive it out on the off side but is late on the shot and his fun is over for the day
Looks for the yorker outside off, Head squeezes it to mid-off
Oh, Travis Head that's exquisite stuff! A loopy, dipping slower yorker and Head backs away and waits on it before creaming it through extra cover
This is fuller on the stumps and Head hits a crisp drive, but straight to the cover fielder
Punched authoritatively through covers! Length ball looking to cramp Head, but he backs away leg side and hits a punchy drive between cover and mid-off. Travishek getting into gear now!
Oh that's easy for Head! Length ball angled into him and he just uses the pace to swivel and help it along over the short fine leg fielder to his right
Now Bhuvi goes on a length outside leg and Head can only get a nudge on it down the leg side. Jitesh does well to get a glove on it to deflect it towards short fine
On a length outside leg, following Abhishek, and can only punch it down the ground to wide of mid-on. Bhuvneshwar does well to cramp Abhishek there
Full around leg, flicked away through square leg
Now Abhishek skips out and towards leg side to this length ball and tucks it to deep backward square
And now he flicks it over midwicket! This is on a good length around middle and leg and Abhishek makes good use of his wrists to whip this away
Oh, just beats the deep backward square fielder! Full on leg and Abhishek flicks it away over the pads. Krunal Pandya runs to his right but it's a bit too far for him to stop
Wham! Short on leg and Head latches on to it, pulling it away over midwicket. Clears the infield with ease
Full inswinger on leg, Head squeezes it to mid-on
Steers this 143kph length ball fine of backward point. Cheers go out as Kohli runs across to collect the ball
Slashes at this back of length delivery angled across and gets it away to deep backward point
On a length outside leg, Head can only parry to midwicket
Just a tad short around leg and Head pulls it away in front of square leg. Good work from Venky Iyer at deep square leg to run across and put in the slide to stop the boundary
Very low full toss on the stumps and Abhishek can only block this back towards the bowler, who can't pick it up but mid-off mops up

Hammered over mid-off and it goes all the way! No foot movement needed there from Abhishek as he takes on this outswinger. Just a small step forward and he hits this on the up and lofts it down the ground. First six of the day
Full around leg, swinging some ways across Head, who flicks it away to deep backward square
Now Bhuvneshwar goes full on the stumps and Head blocks it back
And we're away! Not quite a half-tracker and only a bit of width on offer and that's all Travis Head needs! Stands tall and slaps it away behind point
Now an inswinger goes down leg! Jitesh dives and gets a glove on it to slow it down. SRH get their first runs on the board
Full around middle, swinging away and across Abhishek, who eases a drive to cover point
Length ball on leg stump, he works this to deep square leg. RCB go down by 55 runs, but they won't mind. They have sealed a top spot, while SRH remain at No. 3
Slower back of a length ball on middle and leg, David pulls to deep square leg
Six followed by a four. Rising back of a length ball outside off, he scythes it over extra cover
Slammed into RCB's dugout. Slower offcutter on a length on off stump, he shanks it, gets it right off the splice but still clears long-on
Fuller on off stump, he pushes to mid-off
Sloppy from Shivang. Slower offcutter down leg, he tickles this to short fine leg, where Shivang fumbles and allows two
Some grip and turn for Head. Lands the ball on a length on leg stump and pushes towards cover
Floated outside off, he jumps down the track and has to reach for the ball but gets it to sweeper cover
Tossed up on the stumps, Pandya brings out the sweep and nails it to the deep square leg fence
Fuller on off stump, he pushes to long-on for a run. RCB will finish the league stage at the top of the points table

A wicket off his second ball; Head says I should be a regular bowler, Patty. The good old long-hop does the trick. Dragged down on middle, Patidar pulls but gets more height than distance with deep midwicket taking a comfortable catch right at the boundary
Pushed quicker on leg stump, he misses the sweep and is struck on the back leg. The ball was missing leg stump

That is an incredible shot. How he's managed to get it over deep midwicket, I will never know. A low full toss on middle stump, Patidar somehow gets under it, swivels and whips it over the fence for a six.
Fuller on off stump, he eases to long-on
Banged in short at pace outside off, he has to bail out of the pull at the last moment
Low full toss outside off, he slices to extra cover and doesn't risk the run
Banged in short outside off stump, he pulls this neatly to deep midwicket to bring up a 37-ball half-century
Slower bouncer on off stump, he pulls this fiercely to deep midwicket
Length ball decking back into Pandya who is struck on the pad with the ball rolling to the offside.
Slower length ball on off, he clips this to deep midwicket

Width and Patidar cashes in! Short with lots of width for Patidar who throws his hands at it and carves it to the deep backward point fence. RCB have confirmed a top two spot, with GT the second team.
Back of a length ball on off stump, he swipes to extra cover and sets off. A direct hit and Pandya was done
Slower back of a length ball outside off, Pandya toe-ends this to the keeper
Does that carry to long-off? Nope. Fuller on off stump, he chips it almost straight to the fielder, who collects on the bounce
Nearly a waist high full toss on off stump, he pulls to deep midwicket
Rubbing salt into the would and all that. Slower short ball outside off stump, he smashes that to the right of extra cover

Two balls, two chances for Patidar. Sakib makes a mess of it running back from short fine leg. Banged in short aiming for his body. Patidar is cramped for room as he gets inside the line and attempts a pull. He gets a top-edge with the ball spooning straight up and over short fine leg's head. Sakib runs back, circles around and shells it. What's worse, the ball goes for a four too

Dropped by Cummins at extra cover. A relatively straightforward chance. Slower back of a length ball outside off, Patidar crunches that but at a comfortable height for Cummins, who gets both hands to it and spills it
Nails the yorker on off stump, he squirts this to the right of backward point and some excellent running gets them two
Slower short of a length ball outside off, Patidar looks to cut that up and over but is deceived by the lack of pace
A knee-high full toss again outside off stump, he drives through extra over for a couple of runs
Another low full toss down leg, he whisks this to deep backward square leg
Low full toss on middle and leg, he flicks this neatly but straight to midwicket
Fuller outside off, he carves this inside out over covers to sweeper cover
On a length on off stump, he works this to midwicket and sets off
Slower bouncer but that is too high and is called a wide
Patidar welcomes him with a boundary. Offcutter bowled into the surface on middle and leg, he gets inside the line and pulls to the vacant fine leg fence
Fuller in length on middle and leg, he works this to deep midwicket
A misfield from Head gets Patidar four. A very high full toss outside off stump, Patidar carves this to Head at backward point on the bounce, who misses the ball and concedes four
Right off the cue end of the bat. Good length ball on off stump, he was way too early into his pull and toe-ends back to the bowler
Pinpoint yorker on middle stump, Pandya digs it out to the on-side
Splices this in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket. On-pace bouncer outside off stump, Krunal pulls, right off the top part of the bat with the ball falling in no-man's land
Starts off with a knee-high full toss on the stumps, he gets across and scoops him to the fine leg fence
Slower back of a length ball down leg, Patidar gets inside the line trying to work that fine but misses
Another slower ball almost foxes Pandya. Good length ball, was the offcutter on middle stump, Pandya checks his shot and gets it to long-off
On a length on leg stump, Pandya flicks but only as far as midwicket
Wayward short of a length ball down leg, he pulls to the deep fine leg fence for four
Oh, that's an excellent slower ball. Banged in short with all the pace taken off outside off. Krunal wanted to play the scoop but is beaten
Length ball on leg stump, he works this to deep backward square leg
Dragged down and punished! Long-hop well outside off stump, he waits for it and absolutely belts this through extra cover for a four
Googly turning away from Patidar, he opens the face of the bat and guides to backward point for a quick run
Flatter and fuller on the stumps, he pushes to long-on
Flatter googly but down leg, fizzes past the 'keeper as Krunal misses the sweep. Sakib though hares behind it from short short third and saves two runs for his team
Loopy shin-high full toss down leg, Patidar is early into his sweep and gets a top-edge down past the 'keeper for a run

Huge appeal for lbw, not given and think he was struck outside the line there. Shivang is confident, but the bowlers always are. Will Cummins review? Oh, he does Quicker length ball on off stump, Patidar goes for a sweep and misses. No bat, on we go. The impact is umpire's call and the ball would have missed off stump. SRH are out of reviews.
Length ball angling back into Patidar, he presents the full face of the bat and punches to long-on
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he mistimes to long-off
Banged in short outside off, he ramps this to deep third. Off goes the siren for a no-ball, not because Cummins overstepped but because only three fielders were inside the circle.
Fuller in length on off stump, he pushes to long-on for a run

Slower good length ball outside off stump, he looks for a cut and missed. Oh, that's been called a wide. Wow, think that's a harsh call. Cummins has reviewed. I thought that looked tight with the ball passing over the tramline. Yeah, some part of the ball is passing inside the wide guide line, the wide decision is overturned.
Slower back of a length ball on off, Patidar steers this to deep third for a run
Slower bouncer but that is too high outside off, he lets that go. Called a wide and Kishan fumbles as well
Pandya has belted that! Cummins bowl fuller outside off stump, extravagant movement in and around the crease from Pandya who slams this through the vacant mid-off region
Full outside leg, Krunal backs away and pushes this back towards the bowler and Harshakl gets a hand on it. If he had deflected it to the stumps, Patidar was a goner, as he was out of the crease!
Slower short ball again, Patidar once again pulls it away along the ground to deep square leg
Pulls away this short ball very hard, but can't get it straight enough of the deep midwicket fielder
Full toss outside off, Patidar eases it down to long-on. Came to him at an awkward height
Dug in short, Pandya pulls it away to deep midwicket
Slower short ball outside off, Patidar pulls it away to deep square leg

Malinga greets Pandya with the bouncer, Pandya looks to ramp but apparently doesn't get bat on it. Malinga, however, thinks otherwise and convinces Pat Cummins to send it upstairs. Ball went very close to the outside edge there. But there's no spike on UltraEdge, so SRH will lose the review and Krunal will continue

Oh no, he's picked out the fielder! Malinga with the breakthrough, another big wicket. Full on middle and Padikkal flicks it away on the leg side. Doesn't get under it so it goes flat to deep midwicket
Short outside off, Patidar waits on the slower bouncer and dabs this to deep third
Bouncer climbing on Patidar, who gets his head away and tries to hook it away. No contact, though
Length ball angled across and Padikkal chips it down the ground. Goes to long-on on the bounce
Slower ball, full outside off, steered to deep third
139kph short ball angled across and Padikkal is beaten by the pace as he has a swish at it
Back of length slower ball outside off, Patidar drops it behind point for a single
Low full toss, driven along the carpet to long-off
Now a pace-on bouncer that Padikkal stays away from
Length ball finishing just outside off, blunted back to the bowler's right
Pace-off full ball and Padikkal lofts it over cover. Finds the gap between deep cover and long-off. Padikkal has been so good this season
Short ball, pace off, and Padikkal initially shaped for the pull but makes the late call to dab it to short third's right
Slower short ball outside off, steered to deep third
Slower short ball around off, Patidar jabs it away through square leg, placing it between the two deep fielders. Picks up two with ease
Length ball angled across, Padikkal gives it a push towards backward point for a quick one
Slower ball, full outside off, Patidar taps it towards midwicket for a quick run
Oh, classy from Patidar! Overpitched wide of off and Patidar leans across and caresses a drive to cover's left
Slower ball outside off, punched down to long-on. RCB have had a better powerplay than SRH in terms of runs, but have lost one wicket more

This time, Kohli hits it straight to cover again, but this time it wasn't a grounded shot and Sakib Hussain has the big fish! Slower ball again, full and wide. Kohli reaches out and looks to hammer it through his favourite area, but can't get enough height on this one. Simple reverse-cup catch in front of his face for Karnataka's R Smaran
Slower ball, full outside off, and Kohli hits a crisp drive but can't clear the cover fielder
Slower ball, full on middle, pushed towards mid-on for a single
Full around off, pace off, and Kohli is early into the shot as he looks to whip it away leg-side. Gets an inside edge onto his pads and they get a leg bye as the ball drops to his right
Starts with a pace-off length ball that Padikkal chops towards cover
Length ball outside off, steered behind point to finish the over with a single
And that's just short of the second tier! Bumped in short and Padikkal picks the length early as he pulls it away high over midwicket. DDP continuing his sublime form
off the mark with a boundary immediately! Full and angled across him and he just opens the blade late to steer it to short third's left. Elegant stuff

And Venkatesh holes out now, Eshan Malinga with the crucial breakthrough. Short ball angled across and Venkatesh looks to pull it away. Doesn't get it off the middle and Abhishek Sharma at deep midwicket runs in and takes a catch while sliding in front. Venky dropped Abhishek in the first innings, but the favour is not returned!
Now Kohli flicks this off his pads through square leg
Length ball well outside off and Kohli fetches it with a swing over midwicket. Deep midwicket runs to his left and keeps it down to two
On a length outside off, punched to point
Now he goes full but too wide
Another short ball punished! Half-tracker again and Venkatesh stands tall and lofts it punchily over long-on and into the SRH dugout!
That's dragged down and that's punished! Venkatesh stands tall and gives it a good whack with a vertical bat over deep midwicket
Arm ball on a length that sort of cramps Venkatesh, who chips it on the bounce to mid-on
Tossed up full and outside off, Venkatesh sweeps this hard again, this time along the carpet and in front of square leg!
And he's greeted with a massive six! This is a slot ball and Venkatesh steps across and slog-sweeps this over square leg
Gets away with a leg-stump full toss as he looks to flick it away! They get a leg-bye as the ball deflects behind square off his pads

Cummins fires in the 140kph wide yorker and Venkatesh stays away expecting a wide, which is not given. RCB review it. A long wait for the replay to fire up with the wide lines and all. Apparently the virtual lines are "not available" and the third umpire checks this by eye. The ball is seen to be right on the tramline when crossing the crease, so the decision stays and RCB lose a review
Glorious! This is very full and just outside off and Venkatesh Iyer manages to loft this over mid-off, even as his bottom hand comes off the handle
Full outside leg, following Kohli who moves down the pitch and backs away to the leg side, and Kohli flicks it away on the bounce to deep midwicket
Now a length ball slides down length
Kohli's mighty wrists on full display here! Full-ish ball outside off and he rolls his wrists as he swings this away to midwicket's right and right in the gap
Length ball angled into him, Kohli helps it along fine on the leg side. NKR at deep fine leg runs to his right and puts in a dive to get to the ball, but the ball eventually dribbles onto the ropes
This time Venkatesh hits it well. 140kph short ball and he pulls it away over midwicket
Another slower ball deceives Venkatesh. Short ball stays low and Venkatesh loses balance as he looks to swing it away
Now Malinga bumps it short and Venky sways away
Slower ball stays low and deceives Venkatesh. This was on the fuller side of good length and Venkatesh looks to slap it away. He'd backed away a bit so he can't reach it
Full-ish and angled across, punchily driven to point
Offcutter on a length outside off, Kohli looks to swipe it away leg side and gets it off the inside edge through backward square
Oh, this goes all the way! This is very full and angled across and he opens the face and slices it over short third. Venky Iyer bringing out a lot of innovation early on in the innings
And Venkatesh Iyer gets the first boundary of the innings in cheeky fashion. Has to move a long way across to this back-of-length delivery and scoops it fine on the leg side
Short ball and Kohli pulls it on the bounce to deep square leg
Full outside off, hint of swing away, Kohli presses forward to block
Full outside leg, Iyer pushes it towards mid-off and gets a single

Venky started slow in his last game, but looks like he has come out with a lot of intent today! Skips down the crease to this length ball angled across and looks to go inside out. Doesn't get all of it but clears mid-off running back. Picks up two to start the chase.
